inactive.label: Inactive (<20 commits in 12 months)
inactive.explanation: Pool-C activity filter: fewer than 20 default-branch commits since 2025-07-01 (GitHub GraphQL count).

not_maven.label: No root pom.xml
not_maven.explanation: No pom.xml at the repository root of the release tag / default branch (or the contents listing was unavailable).

success.label: Qualified
success.explanation: License allowed, cloned, Java-touching commits found, root pom.xml, Java >= 8, JDK switched, Maven install and module listing succeeded.

bad_license.label: License not allowed
bad_license.explanation: The repository license is not in the allow-list of permissive open-source licenses.

no_license_404.label: No LICENSE file
no_license_404.explanation: GitHub's license API returned 404 — the repository publishes no license, so it cannot be redistributed.

license_unresolved.label: License lookup failed
license_unresolved.explanation: The GitHub license API could not be resolved (rate limit / transient error). A run failure, not a repository property.

clone_failed.label: git clone failed
clone_failed.explanation: The repository could not be cloned.

no_java_commits.label: No Java-changing commits
no_java_commits.explanation: None of the scanned commits touches a .java file.

no_pom.label: No root pom.xml at checkout
no_pom.explanation: The checked-out latest Java commit has no root pom.xml.

low_java_version.label: Java < 8
low_java_version.explanation: The root pom.xml declares a Java version below 8.

change_java_env_failed.label: Required JDK unavailable
change_java_env_failed.explanation: The declared Java version could not be provisioned (e.g. a JDK newer than the toolchain bundle, or an unparseable requirement).

maven_install_failed.label: mvn install failed
maven_install_failed.explanation: `mvn clean install -DskipTests` failed during the module-structure check.

multimodule_check_failed.label: Module listing failed
multimodule_check_failed.explanation: The Maven module listing failed — typically unresolvable dependencies, a broken pom, or repository/network issues.

no_usable_modules.label: No jar module
no_usable_modules.explanation: Multi-module project whose reactor contains no non-root module with packaging `jar`.

exception.label: Unexpected error
exception.explanation: An unhandled error occurred while processing this repository (e.g. a truncated clone or an unparseable pom).

dropped_reason_not_recorded.label: Reason not recorded
dropped_reason_not_recorded.explanation: Dropped at Stage 2, but the per-repo outcome log of that run was not preserved.

built.label: Anchor built
built.explanation: The anchor commit compiled, resolved its classpath, uses JUnit, ran its suite under JaCoCo, and test-to-code mapping succeeded.

empty_repo.label: Empty repository
empty_repo.explanation: The repository directory was empty after clone/extract.

commit_fetch_failed.label: Commits API failed
commit_fetch_failed.explanation: The GitHub commits API failed while listing commits (retryable).

no_java_changes_commits.label: No Java-changing commits
no_java_changes_commits.explanation: No commits touching Java files were found in the scanned history.

module_check_maven_install_failed.label: mvn install failed (module check)
module_check_maven_install_failed.explanation: `mvn clean install -DskipTests` failed during the anchor's module-structure check.

module_check_no_usable_modules.label: No jar module
module_check_no_usable_modules.explanation: Multi-module reactor with no `jar` module at the anchor commit.

module_check_failed.label: Module listing failed
module_check_failed.explanation: The Maven module listing failed at the anchor commit (dependency resolution / pom / repository issues).

compilation_error.label: Compilation failed
compilation_error.explanation: `mvn test-compile` (or install) failed at the anchor commit.

failed_to_find_classpath.label: Classpath extraction failed
failed_to_find_classpath.explanation: `mvn dependency:build-classpath` produced no classpath for any module.

jacoco_timeout.label: Test run timed out
jacoco_timeout.explanation: The JaCoCo `mvn test` run exceeded its wall-clock limit (1800 s before F36, 3600 s after).

jacoco_failed.label: Test run failed
jacoco_failed.explanation: The JaCoCo `mvn test` run returned non-zero. Before fix F36 (2026-08-22) any failing test was fatal here; repos dropped for <=3 environment-flaky tests were later rebuilt.

non_junit_project.label: No JUnit
non_junit_project.explanation: JUnit is not on the project's test classpath.

instrumentation_failed.label: Instrumentation failed
instrumentation_failed.explanation: The dynamic test-to-code instrumentation run failed.

no_tests.label: No test classes mapped
no_tests.explanation: No surefire test reports were produced, so no test-to-code mapping exists.

static_collection_timeout.label: Static analysis timed out
static_collection_timeout.explanation: The static source collector exceeded 1200 s (after the build itself succeeded).

static_collection_failed.label: Static analysis failed
static_collection_failed.explanation: The static source collector failed (after the build itself succeeded).

not_attempted.label: Never completed a build attempt
not_attempted.explanation: The build task crashed or was killed before any outcome was recorded (disk-full, runaway kill, VM loss).

s4_success.label: Records collected
s4_success.explanation: Commit mining produced dependency-change test records; the repo is in the dataset.

no_diff_in_window.label: No co-evolution data in window
no_diff_in_window.explanation: The 2019-01 -> 2026-06 window yielded no dependency-change test records (see sub-reason).

abandoned_consecutive_failures.label: Abandoned (5 consecutive build failures)
abandoned_consecutive_failures.explanation: Five consecutive per-commit builds failed; the remaining window was abandoned as likely unbuildable.

ssh_timeout.label: Leash expired (18 h)
ssh_timeout.explanation: The per-repo SSH leash expired; the run was killed before finishing.

nonzero_exit.label: Run crashed
nonzero_exit.explanation: The Stage-4 run exited non-zero without a parsable outcome (e.g. disk full).

pack_failed.label: Packing failed
pack_failed.explanation: Records were mined but packing/uploading the artifacts failed; the data was not ingested.

test_label_failed.label: Test-run matrix failed
test_label_failed.explanation: The 4-way test-run step failed after diffs were found.

coverage_failed.label: Coverage grading failed
coverage_failed.explanation: The coverage-grading step failed after diffs were found.

ingest_failed.label: Ingestion failed
ingest_failed.explanation: Writing the per-repo JSONL failed after diffs were found.

not_in_build_results.label: Missing from build results
not_in_build_results.explanation: The project was dispatched but absent from the build-results population file.

fetch_failed.label: Result fetch failed
fetch_failed.explanation: Copying the finished JSONL back to the orchestrator failed.

excluded_2019w: abandoned in all-run.label: Abandoned (decided in all-run)
excluded_2019w: abandoned in all-run.explanation: Abandoned after 5 consecutive commit-build failures in the earlier `all` campaign (500-commit cap, no date window); not re-attempted for 2019w.

excluded_2019w: leash_killed_18h.label: Leash-killed (decided in all-run)
excluded_2019w: leash_killed_18h.explanation: Killed at the 18 h leash in the earlier `all` campaign; excluded from 2019w pending instrumentation fixes.

excluded_2019w: retry_exhausted.label: Retries exhausted (all-run)
excluded_2019w: retry_exhausted.explanation: Repeated timeouts in the earlier `all` campaign; not re-attempted for 2019w.

excluded_2019w: pack_failed unresolved.label: Pack failure unresolved (all-run)
excluded_2019w: pack_failed unresolved.explanation: Packing failed in the earlier `all` campaign and was not resolved for 2019w.

unresolved_in_flight.label: Run in progress
unresolved_in_flight.explanation: This anchor is part of a Stage-4 round that had not finished when this snapshot was built.

no_java_commits_in_window.label: No Java commits in window
no_java_commits_in_window.explanation: The 2019-01 -> 2026-06 window contains no Java-touching commits.

no_coevolution_candidates.label: No co-evolution candidates
no_coevolution_candidates.explanation: Java commits exist, but no commit (or adjacent pair) touches both production and test code.

all_candidate_builds_failed.label: Candidate commits unbuildable
all_candidate_builds_failed.explanation: Co-evolution candidates exist but every candidate commit failed to build.

no_dependency_change_records.label: No dependency-change records
no_dependency_change_records.explanation: Pairs were built and diffed, but no test change had a changed same-module production dependency.

new_on_new != pass.label: New test fails on new code
new_on_new != pass.explanation: The updated/inserted test does not pass at rev2 (compilation failure, test failure, or no run was recorded).

no focal code.label: No focal production code
no focal code.explanation: No production method with source code could be associated with the test change.

test is refactoring only.label: Test change is refactoring-only
test is refactoring only.explanation: RefactoringMiner classifies the test-method change as pure refactoring.

all deps are refactoring only.label: Production changes refactoring-only
all deps are refactoring only.explanation: Every changed production dependency is a pure refactoring.

has test dep change.label: Test-utility co-change
has test dep change.explanation: A dependency of the test is itself test code (helper/fixture), so the co-evolution signal is not production-driven.

commit pair > 12h.label: Commit pair spans > 12 h
commit pair > 12h.explanation: rev1 and rev2 are more than 12 hours apart (only enforced for non-same-commit pairs).

no coverage data.label: No coverage data
no coverage data.explanation: Coverage instrumentation produced no data for this record, so coverage-based classification is impossible.

inserted: no new_on_old result.label: No new-on-old run
inserted: no new_on_old result.explanation: The inserted test has no usable run result on the old code.

old_on_old != pass.label: Old test fails on old code
old_on_old != pass.explanation: The pre-existing test does not pass at rev1, so it cannot serve as a baseline.

test_update_positive.label: Test update (track)
test_update_positive.explanation: Old test passes on old code, fails on new code, and the updated test passes and is discriminating.

test_refinement_cov_improve.label: Refinement (coverage improved)
test_refinement_cov_improve.explanation: Old test still passes on new code; the update improves coverage.

test_refinement_no_cov_improve.label: Refinement (no coverage gain)
test_refinement_no_cov_improve.explanation: Old test still passes on new code; the update does not improve coverage.

test_update_negative.label: No-update-needed
test_update_negative.explanation: The production dependency changed but the test was correctly left unchanged.

test_generation_fail_error_old.label: Test generation (track)
test_generation_fail_error_old.explanation: A new test that passes on new code and fails/errors on old code (discriminating).

test_generation_pass_old.label: Test generation (redundant)
test_generation_pass_old.explanation: A new test that also passes on the old code (not discriminating).

recovered_f36.label: Recovered by F36 rebuild
recovered_f36.explanation: Originally dropped when failing tests were fatal in the JaCoCo step; rebuilt successfully after fix F36 (-Dmaven.test.failure.ignore).

unledgered_results.label: Results salvaged (ledger pending)
unledgered_results.explanation: The dispatcher's 18-hour leash killed this run, but it finished on the VM and its results were salvaged afterwards; the run ledger still shows the timeout until the round's close-out reconciliation.

salvaged.label: Salvaged from orphan run
salvaged.explanation: The dispatcher lost this run (leash/clone failure) but the finished results were salvaged by hand; no run log exists.

post_success_static.label: Static analysis failed after success
post_success_static.explanation: The anchor build succeeded and was recorded, but the follow-up static collection step failed.

s1.note: search universe not recorded; only Maven survivors persisted
